First, note: US/Eastern is UTC-5 (standard time, no DST in 1711).  
Asia/Kolkata is UTC+5:30.  

Target offset − source offset = (+5:30) − (−5) = 10:30.  

4:00 + 10:30 = 14:30 (same day).  

No date change needed for time-only wrap, but date depends on location.  
4 AM May 10 in US/Eastern → 14:30 (2:30 PM) May 10 in Kolkata (since adding 10h30m doesn’t cross midnight in Kolkata relative to Eastern’s midnight).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 14:30
